overall_goal: Integrate fire heat distribution, building layout, firefighting resources, and trapped personnel information to predict fire spread paths and generate optimal rescue dispatch plans, highlighting high-risk areas and key rescue routes for real-time decision support to the command center.

tasks.task_goal: Analyze fire heat distribution from visual input
Identify building layout and potential escape routes
tasks.expected_output: building layout map with marked escape routes

tasks.task_goal: Detect human distress signals and trapped personnel from audio
tasks.expected_output: locations of trapped personnel and distress signal classification
inventory of firefighting resources and their locations
rescue dispatch plan highlighting high-risk areas and key rescue routes
